jobs.description:
As an operator, you work with the team to produce and process corrugated cardboard. You set up the machines, monitor the process, and check the quality. You solve small malfunctions yourself; for bigger issues, you can turn to the team leader. You work in an orderly, accurate, and independent way. Apply quickly if you like working in 2 shifts!

You speak fluent Dutch and/or English
You enjoy working independently and can operate a machine
You are accurate, tidy, and have an eye for detail
You are a true team player and eager to learn
You have a technical interest or experience (plus)
You have a diploma in lower or higher secondary education (BSO, TSO)
Experience is not required but is a plus
You have a correct and hardworking attitude

As a production worker, you will work together with a colleague every day to manufacture safety boots 👢. You will place components such as the steel toe cap, lining and sole into the mould. The machine automatically injects the plastic, after which you remove the finished boot. In between production runs, you clean the machine to ensure it is ready for the next production cycle.

After training, you will also be able to operate other machines. You will cut away larger excess pieces and trim fine seams ✂️. You will carry out quality checks and pay close attention to detail. Every boot must meet strict quality standards. With your keen eye for detail, you make sure that only top-quality products leave the facility.

Working together with your colleagues is important. You step in where needed and support each other in achieving the production targets. You work accurately and take pride in the end result. Are you eager to learn and quality-focused? Then this could be the opportunity for you! ✅

Sound like the job for you? Apply now and discover how you can make a difference!

Who are we looking for?

• You have some initial stable experience in a production environment ⚙️
• You speak English well; Dutch is a plus.
• You have your own means of transportation (public transport is not available).
• You are attentive and have an eye for detail. 👀
• You can work at a fast pace and are physically fit. 💪
• You are not afraid of physically demanding work.

As a maintenance mechanic for trucks, you are responsible for the technical maintenance of trailers. You make sure that everything is ready for inspection and carry out interventions where needed. You replace brakes, shock absorbers and other worn parts. Welding work on trailers is also part of your job.

On a typical day, you start by checking trailers scheduled for inspection. You perform planned maintenance and repair defective parts. You assemble and disassemble components, work independently on repairs and coordinate with colleagues when necessary. If you have knowledge of hydraulics or electricity, that's a plus, but not a must. Communication with colleagues and, if needed, customers is in Dutch, French, English or German.

Do you like to get hands-on and make sure everything is in top technical condition? Are you solution-oriented and prefer to work independently? Apply now and take the first step toward this job!

• You have a diploma of lower secondary education or equivalent by experience

• You have at least 1 year of experience as a mechanic

• You can work independently and think in terms of solutions

• You have strong communication skills

• You have a good command of at least one of these languages: Dutch, French, English or German

• Basic knowledge of hydraulics or electricity is a plus, not a requirement

As a Truck Driver CE, you are responsible for transporting goods within Belgium, Northern France, and Southern Netherlands. You load and unload the truck yourself with an electric pallet truck and always check your documents and vehicle. You register everything correctly in the onboard computer. Ready to hit the road independently? Apply now!

• You have a CE driving license and a valid professional competence certificate (code 95).

• You have at least 5 years of experience as a Truck Driver CE.

• You speak fluent Dutch or English.

• You can work independently and are accurate with administration.

• You are comfortable with a PC and onboard computer.

• You are willing to work an average of 12 hours per day.

• You live within commuting distance to Hooglede.

As a welder, you are responsible for manual and semi-automatic welding of different parts. You work precisely and have an eye for quality, because your workmanship directly impacts the final product.

A typical day involves reading technical plans, preparing materials, and handling welding tasks according to given specifications. You assemble the welded components into a solid, durable end product. You work independently, but can also cooperate with other skilled workers when needed.

Are you handy, detail-oriented, and do you take pride in a perfectly finished product? Then this job is for you. Apply now and show your skills!

• You have a technical background or proven welding experience.

• You can read and accurately follow technical plans.

• You are physically fit and enjoy hands-on work.

• You like working independently and pay attention to detail.

• You speak, write, and understand English.

jobs.employer_name: Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels NV
jobs.description:
Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is a subsidiary of Safran Aircraft Engines, based at Brussels Airport (Zaventem & Steenokkerzeel, Belgium), specialized in the inspection, maintenance and repair (MRO) of the advanced LEAP jet engines that power the latest generation of the Airbus A320NEO & Boeing B737MAX narrow body families. The company is a key player in the integrated CFM international MRO network. With more than 75 years of experience, and up to 20 international Part 145 certifications (EASA/ FAA/ CAAC/ …), Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is recognized as a worldwide center of expertise in the air transport industry. More than a 100 airlines, lessors, private aircraft operators and MRO partners have entrusted their engines to our company. We employ over 600 highly skilled, passionate and enthusiastic employees.

Your role:
The Transport Officer is responsible for the daily monitoring and coordination of transport shipments within Europe and to/from non-EU countries. The role ensures that transportation activities are carried out on time, efficiently, and in accordance with established requirements and service levels. The Transport Officer serves as a key link and point of contact between internal teams, freight forwarders/carriers, suppliers, and logistics partners.

Your responsibilities:
Follow-up and monitoring

• Follow up on EU and non-EU transport shipments from booking through to delivery.
• Monitor transport statuses, transit times, and scheduled deliveries.
• Proactively follow up on delays, deviations, and other operational issues.
• Maintain accurate and up-to-date transport administration and reporting.

Carrier / Freight Forwarder Management

• Request and follow up on transport bookings; evaluate and approve transport movements in accordance with specified service requirements.
• In consultation with the manager, select and assign carriers for specific transport routes and freight flows.
• Identify, monitor, coordinate, and escalate structural issues involving transport partners.

KPI and Performance Management

• Monitor and report on carrier performance and identify trends.
• Discuss performance issues with partners, propose improvement actions, and follow up on their implementation.
• Coordinate actions with internal and external stakeholders and contribute to the continuous improvement of transport performance.

Your profile:

• Bachelor's degree level or equivalent through relevant experience.
• Proficiency in standard software applications (MS Office).
• Good knowledge of transport processes, freight forwarding, and the logistics industry.
• Understanding of performance management and strong analytical skills.
• Works in a structured and accurate manner, with strong organizational skills and the ability to prioritize in a dynamic environment.
• Able to anticipate potential issues and correctly assess their possible impact.
• Capable of analysing problems quickly and accurately and proposing practical solutions.
• You speak French or Dutch, you also have a good knowledge of technical English.

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Belgium, holding either an EU passport or a valid work & residence permit. Please note that we do not provide assistance with visa or permit applications.

Robert Half is looking for a Customer Service Representative (Italian/French/English) (M/F/X) in Zaventem.

Do you have excellent knowledge of Italian, French and English? Are you looking for a permanent position within a dynamic and international team? We are seeking a customer-oriented, detail-focused team player for a growing company in the diplomatic sector.

Your responsibilities:

• Customer contact by phone and email;
• Maintain and update customer files (including specific customs documents);
• Perform daily checks, checklists, and follow up on overdue files;
• Work with proprietary software; fast and comfortable using PC;
• Collaborate with internal colleagues and external partners.

Profile:

• Excellent Italian, French and English required; -
• You must have a bachelor or masters degree.
• You live in Belgium and are eligible to work here.
• You can reach the company easily (Zaventem)
• Accurate and detail-oriented, affinity with administrative processes
• Team player, able to work independently; flexibility is a must
You must meet all requirements to be considered for this position.

What will you be doing?

During the season:

You will be part of a dynamic, energetic team that processes 45 tons of carrots per hour. Together with your colleagues, you will:

• Monitoring the operation of machines (conveyor belts, scanners, cutting and packaging systems)
• Check quality and make changes when necessary
• Show initiative and make quick decisions in difficult situations
• Detecting faults, responding immediately to breakdowns and making quick operational decisions
• Making settings and quality improvements
• Seasonal maintenance, minor repairs, and support for the maintenance department – replacing belts, lubrication, sensor adjustment, filter checks, etc.
• Working in accordance with health and safety and hygiene regulations

Out of season:

You will assist with maintenance and repairs to keep our equipment in top condition. This is not a lab job—you will be working on robust washing and sorting lines, not delicate machines in clean rooms. Practical knowledge and hands-on skills are essential.

• Solid technical knowledge and a proactive approach
• Good command of English allowing for effective communication
• Experience working with loaders or forklifts is a plus
• You enjoy working outdoors and aren't afraid to get your hands dirty
• You are responsible, independent, and solution-oriented
• Flexibility to support other departments during quieter periods
• During the high season (July, August, September), it is not possible to take vacation

Are you ready to take the next step in your career as a Technical Operator? As a vital member of our team, you'll work with cutting-edge machinery to produce high-quality steel profiles. You'll become an expert in operating our state-of-the-art equipment, ensuring that production runs smoothly and efficiently.

Every day, you'll engage with complex and simple finishing machines including conventional and CNC-controlled systems like sawing machines, drilling machines, and laser cutters. Your keen attention to detail and commitment to quality will ensure that every component meets our high standards.

We're looking for motivated and eager-to-learn individuals. Apply now to join a supportive environment where your skills will be valued and developed!

• Technical school diploma or equivalent experience

• Proficiency in reading and executing mechanical diagrams

• Fluency in English

• Knowledge of pneumatics and ability to install tubes and test movements

• Passion for technology and a team-oriented mindset

• Eagerness to learn with a conscientious and responsible approach

• Strict adherence to safety rules and flexibility in working hours

Step into a rewarding role as a Lift Technician where your technical prowess will keep crucial lift systems running smoothly. You’ll be part of a dedicated team responsible for installation, maintenance, and repair services, ensuring safety and reliability. Your daily tasks will include troubleshooting, performing mechanical and electrical maintenance, and collaborating closely with clients and team members to deliver top-notch service. 

An average day will see you working independently on various customer sites, primarily within the province of Antwerp. You'll tackle a range of mechanical and electrical challenges, ensuring each lift is operating safely and efficiently. Your problem-solving skills will be put to good use as you diagnose issues and implement effective solutions.

If you’re ready to elevate your career in a role that offers both challenge and opportunity, apply today! Your journey towards becoming a key player in our technical team starts here.

• Technical school diploma or equivalent experience
• Background in mechanical and/or electrical fields
• Valid Category B driving license
• Strong problem-solving skills
• Ability to work independently and manage your schedule
• Good communication skills in English
• Flexible and responsible attitude

Are you looking to kickstart your career in construction? Join us as a General Construction Worker where every day is a new opportunity to make a tangible impact. You'll be working on varied projects, gaining hands-on experience in demolition, masonry, insulation, and more. 

Your typical day will be dynamic and rewarding. You'll assist skilled workers, ensure site safety, and help maintain project flow. Your contribution is critical in creating structures that stand strong and look impressive. 

Ready to put your skills to the test and grow with us? Apply today and be part of a team that values your effort and dedication.

• Experience in construction (minimum one year)

• Communicative English skills

• Physically fit and hardworking

• Motivated to learn and grow in construction

• Flexible and hands-on attitude

• Own transportation (a plus)

• VCA certificate

Are you ready to start your career as a Maintenance Technician in a dynamic and technology-driven environment? As a Maintenance Technician, you'll be at the forefront of ensuring the optimal performance of our client's advanced machinery.

On an average day, you'll troubleshoot machine malfunctions, perform preventive maintenance, and collaborate with machine setters and operators to enhance production processes. Your proactive efforts will contribute to improvements in quality, output, and safety.

If you're eager to embark on a fulfilling career, we encourage you to apply and become a valuable part of our team dedicated to innovation and excellence.

• Technical school degree

• Good level of English

• Flexibility, motivation, and a strong sense of responsibility

• Experience in pneumatics and hydraulics is a plus

• Problem-solving mindset

• Willingness to work shifts
